# `aitbc liquidity build-withdraw`

Build an unsigned LIQUIDITY_WITHDRAW transaction (stake must be unlocked).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc liquidity build-withdraw [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--stake-id` | text | — | yes | Liquidity stake identifier to withdraw |
| `--address` | text | — | no | Sender address (overrides --wallet-name) |
| `--wallet-name` | text | — | no | Wallet whose address is the sender |
| `--pool-id` | text | `main` | no | Liquidity pool identifier (default: main) |
| `--fee` | decimal | `0.01` | no | Transaction fee in AIT |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL (overrides config) |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID the transaction is built for |
| `--json` | flag | `false` | no | Emit the unsigned transaction as JSON |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc liquidity build-withdraw --stake-id <stake_id>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc liquidity build-withdraw --stake-id <stake_id> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
